subject: Fulham 1-1 Newcastle: Murphy's 80th-minute screamer cancelled out three minutes later, pressure on Jaissle grows
title: Fulham 1-1 Newcastle: screamer, instant reply

lines.vo: A screamer, a three-minute reply, and Newcastle still in twelfth place.
lines.footage: Jacob Murphy long-range goal clip, Newcastle celebration

lines.vo: Newcastle drew 1-1 at Fulham. Pressure on head coach Matthias Jaissle is growing.
Jacob Murphy struck from long range in the eightieth minute. Newcastle were ahead for three minutes.
Rodrigo Muniz equalised for Fulham in the eighty-third. Fulham were the better side for much of the game.
A stoppage-time save from Lukas Hornicek prevented a fifth league defeat for Newcastle.
In early October, Newcastle were six points clear of Fulham. Now they are twelfth on twelve points. At least it is tidy.
